source_pca_recipe.rows: All eligible support rows of firstkwholetrials; retain PCA lag rows only if full25binhistory is within that trial. No futuretrial spikes/labels enter statistics.
source_pca_recipe.input: Rawspike counts; perunit mean/std from eligible support rows, standarddeviation floor0.1counts. Readonly non-support arrays may be present in file but cannot affect output.
source_pca_recipe.covariance: Stack normalized25lags for full-window eligible support rows, flatten rows×units into samples×25; center each lag across those samples and divide crossproduct by number samples.
source_pca_recipe.basis: Five eigenvectors corresponding to largest eigenvalues of25x25covariance, descendingorder. Nonnegative tap-sum convention, largest-absolute tap positive if sum effectivelyzero.
source_pca_recipe.scale: Each row scaled to corresponding fixedV1bank row L2norm.
source_pca_recipe.interpretation: Deterministic label-free support initialization. It includes neural inputs of every support fold; reused LOO objective is training, not an independent validation.
source_pca_recipe.failure: Emptyfullwindow/nonfinitecovariance or zero variance explicitfailures, no alternatebasis/substitutedseed/omittedset.
